types.name: CylinderCarouselProps
types.doc: Cards standing around a cylinder that you turn: drag it and let go, use the arrows, or press the arrow keys. It always comes to rest with one card facing you. Cards turn away with real perspective and dim as they go, and the ones at the back are hidden.

members.name: children
members.doc: One card per child. Three or more make a proper cylinder.

members.name: value
members.doc: Index of the card facing the viewer (controlled).

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Index of the card facing the viewer at first when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the index of the card that the cylinder settles on.

members.name: cardWidth
members.doc: Card width in px. It shrinks to fit narrow containers.

members.name: cardHeight
members.doc: Card height in px at full width; it scales with the card's width.

members.name: gap
members.doc: Space in px between neighboring cards, measured along the cylinder.

members.name: perspective
members.doc: Viewing distance in px. Smaller values exaggerate the depth.

members.name: controls
members.doc: Shows the previous and next buttons and the position counter.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
